title: Lock map seam, nurture runner, season go-live and member day with frozen-clock tests

source.ref: Functional QA sweep 2026-10-28, map and timer slice

verify.note: Renders the map seam with both engines stubbed (keyless MapLibre, Google with runtime fallback, expandable dialog) and runs the nurture runner, season auto-go-live and member-day boundaries on a frozen clock against in-memory fakes. No network, no tile provider, no production data.

detail: A source and metadata audit did not exercise map rendering or timer journeys. This adds runtime tests for four paths that had only source-reading or no tests: the MapCanvas seam, runDueNurture, promoteDueScheduledSeasons and memberDay. All passed on first run; no product defect was found in these paths. Findings and what cannot be tested from a cloud box are in audits/functional-qa-2026-10-28/map-and-timer.md. No schema, provider, customer data or deployment changes.
